description: This is a Java JUnit test class for the class BaseOpenmrsObject in the OpenMRS project. It contains unit tests for the equals, hashCode, and toString methods of BaseOpenmrsObject, as well as tests involving Hibernate proxy objects and class inheritance.

classes.name: BaseOpenmrsObjectMock
classes.description: A mock subclass of BaseOpenmrsObject used in testing the equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjHasNullUuid
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when the other object has a null UUID.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNotInstanceOfBaseOpenmrsObject
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false if compared to an object of a different class.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNull
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false when compared to null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Tests that equals returns false if the current object's UUID is null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfObjectsAreTheSame
methods.description: Tests that equals returns true when comparing the same object instance.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfUuidsAreEqual
methods.description: Tests that equals returns true if UUIDs of the objects are equal.

methods.name: hashCode_shouldNotFailIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Ensures that calling hashCode does not fail when the UUID is null.

methods.name: shouldNotBeEqualWhenDifferentClassesAndSameId
methods.description: Checks that different class instances with same ID are not equal.

methods.name: shouldNotBeEqualWhenFirstIsNull
methods.description: Checks that comparison with null returns false.

methods.name: toString_shouldIncludeUuidIfNotNull
methods.description: Verifies toString output includes UUID when UUID is set.

methods.name: toString_shouldIncludeHashCodeIfUuidIsNull
methods.description: Verifies toString output includes hash code and <null> UUID when UUID is null.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsInstanceOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Tests equality between a Concept and a ConceptNumeric with the same UUID.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjIsNotInstanceOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Checks that objects of different classes are not equal.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfGivenObjectIsSubclassOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Checks equality between a parent class Order and subclass DrugOrder with same UUID.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfGivenObjectIsNotSubclassOfSuperOrExtendingClass
methods.description: Verifies that objects of unrelated classes are not equal.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnfalseIfHibernateProxyOfOneThingIsComparedtoHibernateProxyofSomething
methods.description: Ensures that Hibernate proxies of different classes are not equal.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnFalseIfHibernateProxyOfOneThingIsComparedtoNonHibernateProxyofSomething
methods.description: Tests that a Hibernate proxy and a non-proxy instance of a class are not equal, even with same UUID.

methods.name: equals_shouldWorkOnNonHibernateManagedClasses
methods.description: Tests equality logic on non-Hibernate managed custom classes that extend BaseOpenmrsObject.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfHibernateProxyOfOneObjectComparedToNonHibernateProxyOfTheSameObject
methods.description: Checks equality between a Hibernate-loaded object and its proxy.

methods.name: equals_shouldReturnTrueIfHibernateProxyOfSomeObjectComparedToAnotherHibernateProxyOfTheSameObject
methods.description: Verifies that two Hibernate proxies of the same object are considered equal.
